cards.front: skeleton
cards.back: All the bones in the body, joined together.
cards.say: skeleton. All the bones in the body, joined together.

cards.front: skull
cards.back: The bones of the head. They protect the brain.
cards.say: skull. The bones of the head. They protect the brain.

cards.front: ribs
cards.back: Curved bones in the chest. They protect the heart and lungs.
cards.say: ribs. Curved bones in the chest. They protect the heart and lungs.

cards.front: backbone
cards.back: A line of small bones down the back, also called the spine. It supports the body.
cards.say: backbone. A line of small bones down the back, also called the spine. It supports the body.

cards.front: What are three jobs of a skeleton?
cards.back: It supports the body, protects the organs and helps the body move.
cards.say: What are three jobs of a skeleton? It supports the body, protects the organs and helps the body move.

cards.front: Which bones help you stand up straight?
cards.back: The backbone and the leg bones.
cards.say: Which bones help you stand up straight? The backbone and the leg bones.

cards.front: joint
cards.back: A place where two bones meet. Joints let the body bend.
cards.say: joint. A place where two bones meet. Joints let the body bend.

cards.front: Name a joint in your arm.
cards.back: The elbow. The wrist and shoulder are joints too.
cards.say: Name a joint in your arm. The elbow. The wrist and shoulder are joints too.

cards.front: Name a joint in your leg.
cards.back: The knee. The hip and ankle are joints too.
cards.say: Name a joint in your leg. The knee. The hip and ankle are joints too.

cards.front: muscle
cards.back: A body part that pulls on bones to make them move.
cards.say: muscle. A body part that pulls on bones to make them move.

cards.front: Do bones move by themselves?
cards.back: No. Muscles pull on the bones to move them.
cards.say: Do bones move by themselves? No. Muscles pull on the bones to move them.

cards.front: Why could you not stand up without a skeleton?
cards.back: The skeleton holds the body up. Without it the body would be floppy.
cards.say: Why could you not stand up without a skeleton? The skeleton holds the body up. Without it the body would be floppy.

cards.front: vertebrate
cards.back: An animal with a backbone, such as a fish, bird or human.
cards.say: vertebrate. An animal with a backbone, such as a fish, bird or human.

cards.front: invertebrate
cards.back: An animal with no backbone, such as a snail or an insect.
cards.say: invertebrate. An animal with no backbone, such as a snail or an insect.

cards.front: Is a worm a vertebrate or an invertebrate?
cards.back: An invertebrate, because it has no backbone.
cards.say: Is a worm a vertebrate or an invertebrate? An invertebrate, because it has no backbone.

cards.front: Is a cat a vertebrate or an invertebrate?
cards.back: A vertebrate, because it has a backbone.
cards.say: Is a cat a vertebrate or an invertebrate? A vertebrate, because it has a backbone.

cards.front: Which foods help keep bones strong?
cards.back: Foods with calcium, such as milk, cheese and tofu.
cards.say: Which foods help keep bones strong? Foods with calcium, such as milk, cheese and tofu.

cards.front: Why do we wear a helmet when cycling?
cards.back: It helps protect the skull and the brain.
cards.say: Why do we wear a helmet when cycling? It helps protect the skull and the brain.

cards.front: Why do the hands have many small bones?
cards.back: Many small bones let us grip things and make fine movements.
cards.say: Why do the hands have many small bones? Many small bones let us grip things and make fine movements.

cards.front: A crab has a hard shell outside its body. What does the shell do?
cards.back: It supports and protects the soft body inside, like a skeleton on the outside.
cards.say: A crab has a hard shell outside its body. What does the shell do? It supports and protects the soft body inside, like a skeleton on the outside.

cards.front: True or false: Bones are living and can mend if they break.
cards.back: True. A broken bone can heal over time.
cards.say: True or false: Bones are living and can mend if they break. True. A broken bone can heal over time.

cards.front: True or false: Your skeleton stops you from moving.
cards.back: False. Your skeleton helps you move, with muscles pulling the bones.
cards.say: True or false: Your skeleton stops you from moving. False. Your skeleton helps you move, with muscles pulling the bones.
